messages:
ravi: sec-bot flagged a potential leak: archived CI artifact contains a KMS-wrapped blob that decodes to PARTNER_TOKEN_7y. Found in ci-artifacts/build-2025-09.tar.gz. High priority.

sec-bot: (automated) leak_alert severity=high path=s3://ci-artifacts/builds/2025/09/build-2025-09.tar.gz pattern=PARTNER_TOKEN_7y

emma: I'll take lead. Immediate steps: 1) confirm token status with partner 2) rotate secret in Vault (kv v2) 3) rewrap in KMS and record key version 4) scan artifacts and archives for variants.

ravi: partner ops asked for a revocation ticket before we rotate upstream. Opening PART-2026-600 and pinging them.

sre-oncall: while you rotate, enable a short RBAC lockdown on secret path secret/data/integrations/partner and restrict to svc-ci and security-admin for 3 hours.

emma: creating policy now and applying to role. Also generating new token and writing to Vault: 
```bash
vault kv put secret/integrations/partner token="$NEW" rotated_by=emma rotated_at=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
```

sec-bot: post-rotation scan: matches_before=1 matches_after=0 scanned_paths=["s3://ci-artifacts/builds/2025/09","s3://archives/ci/2025"]

emma: KMS rewrap id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/partners/cryptoKeyVersions/12. Vault request_id=req-2b9. Uploaded proof to incident ticket INC-2026-03-21-KMS.

auditor: please export Vault audit lines and KMS key usage for compliance evidence. Need timestamps and request ids.

emma: attached redacted audit entries in ticket. Also patching CI pipeline to run redaction on artifacts before final archive and adding a pre-publish check to reject token-like patterns.

ravi: follow-ups: schedule RBAC review to remove stale svc accounts, add archived-rewrite job to scrub old artifacts, and draft a proposal for ephemeral partner tokens. Assigning owners in the incident.

sre-oncall: creating alert rule: reject archive uploads with regex PARTNER_TOKEN-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,}. Webhook -> sec-bot.

emma: containment complete. Will run a 30-min postmortem tomorrow. Marking INC-2026-03-21-KMS in containment.
